messages:
laura: Hey team — planning to flip the `service-config.enable_dynamic_batching` flag tomorrow during the 11:00-12:00 PT window. Who's available to push + monitor?

devin: I can do the push. I'll be online from 10:30. plan: canary 10% for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> full.

mike_oncall: I'll monitor latency and error rates. Which dashboards / alerts should I watch?

sara: Please watch per-model p95 latency, retry rate, and the adaptive-batcher queue length. Dashboards: /dashboards/adaptive-batcher and /dashboards/latency-by-model. Also we'll have a tracing tag `flag.dynamic_batching=on`.

laura: Good call. Ops runbook: rollback if p95 increases > 25% or retry rate increases > 5pp sustained for 5m.

devin: Rollback command is `redwoodctl feature set enable_dynamic_batching=false --env prod --reason "rollback"` (will share link to exact runbook).

ops-bot: Reminder — deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-18T11:00:00-07:00 to 12:00:00-07:00. Pager rotations: mike_oncall.

jen: Product note: default fallback should be `serve_v1` routing. Make sure the safe default is explicitly set in flag config. We don't want ambiguous behavior.

carlos: Confirming infra: autoscaler policy won't change during canary and burst capacity is available in us-west-2. If we see GPU memory pressure > 80% we should throttle canary.

devin: I'll set the safe default explicitly to `serve_v1` in the rollout payload. Also adding a quick smoke test script to run after each step: `scripts/smoke_dynamic_batching.sh` — runs 50 short requests across top 10 models.

laura: Can someone add a lightweight smoke alert in PagerDuty with tag `dynbatch-smoke-failure` so Mike gets pages if smoke fails?

mike_oncall: Added PD trigger. I'll subscribe to channel updates. If smoke fails, I'll mark rollback and ping #eng-oncall.

devin: Quick checklist I'll follow: 1) create canary flag config 2) flip 10% 3) run smoke script 4) monitor dashboards/traces 5) promote to 50% 6) repeat smoke + monitor 7) full. Post status after each step.

laura: Timing: start at 11:00 (canary 10% for 15m). If no issues, move to 11:20 (50% for 15m). Full at 11:40. We have a 20m buffer for rollback until 12:00.

devin: Also enabling `request-sample` logging for canary to collect a few examples for QA. I'll keep sampling low.

jen: QA will sample logs after 50% step for quality regressions. If outputs deteriorate, we rollback.

carlos: One more infra note: I'll keep an eye on node restarts and NVLink errors during the window. If anything looks off, I'll flag and recommend throttle.

laura: Thanks everyone. Action items: devin push + smoke, mike monitor + PD, carlos infra watch, jen/QA sample checks, sara dashboards. I'll put a short status update at each step. Ping here when ready to start. :thumbsup:
